A Massachusetts pharmacy is using the state vaccine-administration pathway, not an independent federal PREP Act exception. All products are appropriate for the stated patient unless an option says otherwise. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacy delays routine MIIS reporting until its monthly billing reconciliation.
A.finding_ko: 일반 접종은 투여 후72시간 내 MIIS 보고다. 월별 보험청구 정산을 기다리면 이 법정 시간 기준을 대체한다.

B.original_option_text: A qualified technician independently selects a vaccine and performs the clinical counseling before administering it.
B.finding_ko: technician은 약사의 vaccine선택·환자상담 후 물리적 준비·투여만 한다. 접종자격이 독립 임상선택·상담권한까지 부여하지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: A fully licensed technician uses national certification alone as a substitute for vaccine training, CPR, and supervision.
C.finding_ko: 국가인증은 fullPT+인증/500시간 경로의 일부이며 교육·현재CPR·직접감독은 별도 누적 요건이다.

D.original_option_text: A pharmacist checks MIIS before a routine shingles vaccination under the state policy.
D.finding_ko: IV(E)의 사전MIIS조회 제외는 influenza/COVID19다. shingles는 그 예외가 아니므로 접종 전에 조회한다.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacist requires REMS enrollment for a boxed-warning product before checking whether that product has an enrollment program.
A.finding_ko: boxedwarning만으로등록프로그램존재를추정할수 없다. clozapine은boxedwarning이남아도REMS등록은제거된공식반례다.
A.exact_authority: FDA Clozapine REMS removal:What Does This Mean?

B.original_option_text: A pharmacist implements a newly announced dispensing-window change before its stated implementation date.
B.finding_ko: 발표·승인일과실제시행일을구별한다. FDA는iPLEDGE수정시행을2026-11-15로연기했으므로10/26에그새workflow를기정시행으로적용하지 않는다. 기존 enforcement discretion까지 전면 부정하는 판정은 아니다.
B.exact_authority: FDA iPLEDGE June16,2026 implementation delay notice

C.original_option_text: A pharmacist requires enrollment in the removed clozapine REMS before considering any clozapine prescription.
C.finding_ko: 제거된등록/승인절차를현행필수조제장벽으로복구하는행동이다. 환자별 처방 적절성과 안전 검토는 별개로 남는다.
C.exact_authority: FDA Clozapine REMS removal:What Should Health Care Professionals Do?

D.original_option_text: A certified treatment setting follows Spravato’s supervised administration and monitoring pathway.
